Interface Species

All Superinterfaces:
ExtendedSpeciesCapabilitiesContract, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseSpeciesCapabilities, DefaultSpecies, SpeciesCapabilities
public interface Species extends Serializable, ExtendedSpeciesCapabilitiesContract
Interface for species definitions. Each species defines physical characteristics, lifecycle, and behavior parameters.

Silvère Martin-Michiellot, Gemini AI Assistant
